notes: Portrait sheet (zoning SHEET 5, 1978). No frame rule on the left or right: blank paper (and, on the left, the shoreline/PACIFIC OCEAN lettering well inside) out to the page edges, so the outline follows them (README rule 5). Top: a thin printed rule (~9 px) runs across the top margin, sloping from y ~25-34 at x 30 to y ~0-3 at x ~2950, where it runs off the top of the scan; it is treated as the top frame rule and the outline sits ~1.5 px below its lower edge (rule 1), carried on along its slope out to both page edges (y ~36 at x 0, ~2 at x 3300). Doubt: p01 of this series has no top rule; this one is printed, so the sliver of paper above it is outside. Bottom: just above the top edge of the thick bar (~26 px, x ~36-2990) that rules off the legend/title strip (district legend, code note, north arrow, SHEET 5), rule 3, measured column by column (y ~3847 at the left, ~3797 at the right), carried on to both page edges. No remove polygons (north arrow in the legend strip). GOLDEN GATE PARK, PACIFIC OCEAN and district codes are map. No ink under the outline.
